doc.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000

title: Jazz worldwide and swing dancing's return
summary: Jazz is recognised as an art form and swing dancing is back a little.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Right. Well I just am humbled to have a part in such an operation and I love it when I see how jazz is spread all over the world, it’s like an international thing now.
Something that this country can be very proud of. And I think it has become recognized as an art form. I wish the dance halls still existed in a sense, so that it could exist in that world also.
Well you know the swing dancing is back. I wondered if that wouldn’t give birth to something, and it has a little bit but not very much.
